qp_model_provenance.google_data_role: guide for broad event scales only; no Sycamore coordinate correction or per-event matching
qp_model_provenance.generation_prior_selection: synthetic non-saturation check only; 128 generated events, no real syndrome outcomes used
qp_model_provenance.generation_quantity: local QP-generation density proxy sampled at each qubit coordinate; summing over qubits is not deposited energy
qp_model_provenance.energy_conservation_scope: not modeled; required only for particle-energy, dose, material, or chip-geometry prediction
qp_model_provenance.hardware_semantics: one persistent 100 us / 200 us / 5 GHz reference device and per-qubit calibration map is sampled once; run/event hardware drift is disabled
qp_model_provenance.reference_hardware: Baity et al., arXiv:2602.06202; replace with measured calibration for a target device
qp_model_provenance.intended_use: phenomenological superconducting-QEC stress-test data generation and sensitivity studies; not absolute hardware prediction

model: StandardScaler + independent x/y RBF SVR, C=1, epsilon=0.1, gamma=0.57/120, same main-protocol split and features.
